placement: Before existing Pre / Pre Grade, otherwise before Grade 1; preserve IDs and chronology of current levels.
book_sequence: Joggers before Runners; pedagogical sequence only, no new automatic exam/prerequisite gate.
source_notes: Both supplied PDFs have 38 pages. Printed pages 3-16 map to PDF 4-17; PDF 18-21 are inserted advertising pages; printed 17-32 usually map to PDF 22-37.
BOOK 1 EXCEPTION: printed page 23 is PDF 29; printed page 24 is PDF 28. Preserve Contents order: piece 33 before pieces 34-35, despite the reversed scan pages.
Book 1 has 47 numbered pieces, not 53. Numbers 48-53 marked Practice tempo are audio track references.
Book 2 has 38 numbered pieces, not 44. Numbers 39-44 marked Practice tempo are audio track references.
Book 1: 47 pieces plus Open strings, First finger and Fact-Finder = 50 lessons. Embed the Second finger and Third/fourth finger introductions into pieces 21 and 32 respectively.

Book 2: 38 pieces + two introductory boxes + Fact-Finder + 9 extra source-specific subdivisions = 50 lessons. Six duets each get upper-staff and lower-staff/ensemble lessons; pieces 9, 28 and 36 each have two distinct scoped lessons.
Book 2 duets have parts of equal difficulty. Do not label every lower staff a teacher-only part. Book 1 begins with starred easier parts and explicitly revisits harder parts later.
No audio files were supplied. No links or playable CD assets are inferred. Do not create lessons for covers, advertising, credits, or other books shown in ads.

Pre Step is the requested VIBE placement, not a claim of equivalence to an examination grade. Joggers/Runners are repertoire-led methods; instrument sizing, posture, hold and tuning require teacher-led preparation not contained comprehensively in these attachments.
Fifty lessons are VIBE editorial teaching units, not fifty publisher-numbered compositions or fixed class meetings.
